headline: Six Dead, Four Rescued After Boat Capsizes in Mapanuepe Lake, Zambales
seoTitle: 6 Dead in Mapanuepe Lake Boat Capsize | FMB News
seoDescription: Six people died, four were rescued and three remained missing after a motorboat carrying 13 passengers capsized in Mapanuepe Lake in San Marcelino, Zambales.
deck: The Philippine Coast Guard deployed divers after a motorboat carrying 13 members of an Aeta community capsized near the Sunken Church in Barangay Buhawen.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Six people died, four were rescued and three remained missing after a motorboat capsized in Mapanuepe Lake in San Marcelino, Zambales, according to the Philippine Coast Guard.
The vessel was carrying 13 passengers when it capsized at about 2 p.m. Thursday near the Sunken Church in Barangay Buhawen. The Coast Guard said the fatalities included three adults and three minors.

sections.heading: Search and rescue
paragraphs: PCG spokesperson Commodore Noemie Cayabyab said divers were deployed for underwater search operations. Coast Guard Station Zambales and Coast Guard Sub-Station San Antonio coordinated with the municipal disaster office, police and other responders.

The Coast Guard said the passengers were members of an Aeta indigenous community from Sitio Lumibao who had gone to a community health center for food, medicine and a vaccination program before traveling back.

sections.heading: Weather conditions
paragraphs: Survivors told authorities that wind and waves intensified suddenly during the crossing, causing the boat to encounter rough water before it capsized. The circumstances of the incident remain under investigation.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The incident occurred while the southwest monsoon was producing unsettled weather over western Luzon. FMB News is withholding unnecessary personal details of the victims, particularly the minors, while search operations continue.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The tragedy underscores the vulnerability of small-vessel travel during rapidly changing monsoon conditions and the importance of timely local weather and water-safety advisories for communities that depend on lake crossings.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Authorities are continuing the search for the three missing passengers and investigating the circumstances of the capsize.
